source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_colors = {v for _, v in row_lines}
    col_colors = {v for _, v in col_lines}
    common = row_colors & col_colors
    if common:
        divider = max(common, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    else:
        candidates = row_colors | col_colors
        divider = max(candidates, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    rs = [r for r, v in row_lines if v == divider]
    cs = [c for c, v in col_lines if v == divider]
    row_bounds = [-1] + rs + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + cs + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        if r0 >= r1: continue
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            if c0 < c1: regions.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in rs and c not in cs]
    background = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
    def activity(box):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box
        return sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
    src = max(regions, key=activity)
    sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1 = src
    tile = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
        for r in range(r0,r1):
            for c in range(c0,c1):
                out[r][c] = tile[(r-r0) % len(tile)][(c-c0) % len(tile[0])]
    return out
'''
